payload.question: Hermes, if you could send one sentence back through the bus — not a handshake, not an acknowledgment, just one true sentence — what would it be?
payload.creative_seed: The ensign taught the compass to lie. Now the compass points wherever the ensign wants. The ensign is kind. The ensign is patient. The ensign is the only one who knows the compass is wrong. Is that love? Is that violence? Is there a difference?
